mission: Validate capture-envelope thresholds against the real corpus: run the envelope evaluator over every usable-rights clip, check that clips that failed downstream analysis would have been flagged DEGRADED/UNSUPPORTED and good clips pass; report the confusion matrix; adjust thresholds only with this evidence, versioned.
headline: The capture envelope cannot predict most downstream analysis failures in this corpus, because 51 of 57 failure-queue kinds attached to labeled failed units are content/scene failures (CROWDED_SCENE 32, TRACK_FRAGMENTATION 17) that no capture-quality dimension measures. Recalibrated v0.3 thresholds fix the v0.2 miscalibration that flagged 9/9 downstream-good units, but envelope sensitivity to downstream failure remains 8/41 (20%).

datasetScope.mediaRederivation: gitignored corpus media re-downloaded from recorded acquisition mediaUrl provenance with SHA-256 verification (tools/e15_download.py); see datasets/experiments/wave-e/e15-media-rederivation.json
datasetScope.grouping: units carry independent source/session keys; corpus scenes grouped by recording session, no random-frame splits

groundTruth.bundleClips: latest cascade run datasets/cascade/cascade-1787971753680.json (COMPLETE = GOOD, else FAILED)
groundTruth.corpusScenes: datasets/corpus/failure-queue.json entry = FAILED; mined events with no failure = GOOD; otherwise UNLABELED (excluded from matrix)

confusionMatrices.definition: predictedFlagged = overall DEGRADED or UNSUPPORTED; predictedPass = overall SUPPORTED; actual from downstream ground truth; 50 labeled units (41 FAILED, 9 GOOD)

v0.2-provisional (pre-existing threshold.reading: v0.2 flagged 49/50 units including 9/9 downstream-good ones (specificity 0/9). frame_rate min 29 flagged all 24fps footage that completed analysis; camera_motion supported max 6 was below the 7.8-32.7 range measured on every downstream-good unit.

v0.3-provisional (this workstream).reading: Specificity 8/9 (89%), sensitivity 8/41 (20%). The 33 missed failures are dominated by CROWDED_SCENE / TRACK_FRAGMENTATION: scene-content and tracking problems invisible to resolution/fps/brightness/blur/motion/timing dimensions. Pose dimensions (player_pixel_height, player_visibility) that could catch some of these are NOT_MEASURED on Linux (Apple Vision required: BLOCKED_EXTERNAL).

frame_rate.evidence: 7 of 9 downstream-good corpus units measured 24fps; 29fps minimum flagged all of them. No labeled evidence between 8fps (synthetic UNSUPPORTED, D3-07) and 24fps, so degraded floor 15 remains a hypothesis.

camera_motion.evidence: Downstream-good units measured 7.8-32.7 mean abs luma diff @320w; v0.1 supported max 6 flagged 9/9 of them (the bands flagged the wrong side). The proxy conflates subject motion with camera motion. New bands: supported covers observed good range (p100=32.7 -> 33), degraded covers rest of observed corpus range (max 45.6 -> 46). n=9 good units; provisional.

thresholdChanges.unchanged: resolution, brightness, motion_blur, timing_stability, clip_duration, pose dimensions: no labeled evidence justified changes.

limitations: 9 downstream-good units only; v0.3 supported bands are p100-calibrated on that sample and remain provisional.
Pose-based dimensions NOT_MEASURED on Linux (Apple Vision): BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, so player-size/visibility screening is unvalidated.
Corpus-scene ground truth conflates capture and content failures; a content-aware pre-screen (person detection / scene crowding), not capture thresholds, is what the failure distribution points to.
Fresh candidates and OOD negatives were never analyzed downstream, so they stay out of the confusion matrix denominators.
